t: Section 203(b) of the Act is amended (1) by inserting after “State” the second time it appears in paragraph (1) the following “(as determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data)”, (2) by inserting after “States” the second time it appears in such paragraph the following “(as so determined)”, (3) by inserting after “State” the second time it appears in paragraph (2) the following “(as determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data)”, and (4) by inserting after “States” the second time it appears in paragraph (2) the following “(as so determined)”.

fable.w: This section only makes technical amendments that insert parenthetical phrases specifying that State figures are determined from the latest appropriate data, apparently for an allotment formula. The tempting reading is that the mention of "State" and "States" signals consultation with state governments, but States appear only as units in a calculation. There is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue.
fable.s: (as determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data)

opus.w: This is a technical amendment saying that state figures in section 203(b) are to be 'determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data.' The word 'State' tempts a Yes reading, but here states are only units in a calculation, not parties consulted before a federal decision. The section has no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue.
opus.b:
**Step 1 – Analysis.** The tempting reading is that "State" refers to an outside party, so the section might involve states in a federal decision. That fails because "State" appears here only as a word in a formula. The amendment only specifies that state figures are "determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data." It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. No outside party takes part in any federal decision.

It does not establish any process for consultation, comment, or coordination with parties outside the federal government. qwen_chat.s: Section 203(b) of the Act is amended (1) by inserting after “State” the second time it appears in paragraph (1) the following “(as determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data)”, (2) by inserting after “States” the second time it appears in such paragraph the following “(as so determined)”, (3) by inserting after “State” the second time it appears in paragraph (2) the following “(as determined on the basis of the latest appropriate data)”, and (4) by inserting after “States” the second time it appears in paragraph (2) the following “(as so determined)”.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "latest appropriate data" implies some form of public input or consultation to determine what data is appropriate. However, the text merely specifies the source of data for a calculation or determination, not a process for public participation. There is no mention of hearings, comments, advisory boards with outside members, or consultation with non-federal entities. The amendments are purely technical adjustments to how data is referenced in the statute.
